questions.question: What is the title of the newly compiled book featuring Prime Minister Modi’s speeches on Indian culture and values?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Sanskriti Ka Paanchva Adhyay**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• PM Modi’s book on Indian culture Sanskriti Ka Paanchva Adhyay to be released in New Delhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
A new book titled **"Sanskriti Ka Paanchva Adhyay"** is being released in **New Delhi**.

 
 
• 
 
It is a **compiled collection of PM Narendra Modi’s speeches** on **culture, traditions, spirituality, and heritage**.

 
 
• 
 
The book is being formally released by **Acharya Mahamandaleshwar Pujya Swami Avdheshanand Giri Maharaj**, Head of the **Juna Akhara**.

 
 
• 
 
**Foreword** is written by **Ram Bahadur Rai**.

 
 
• 
 
The **compilation** is done by **Dr. Prabhat Ojha**.

 
 
• 
 
The **publisher** of the book is **Prabhat Prakashan**.

questions.question: Who has been appointed the 52nd Chief Justice of India after the retirement of CJI Sanjiv Khanna?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Justice B R Gavai.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Chief Justice Sanjiv Khanna named Justice B R Gavai as his successor, who will become the 52nd Chief Justice of India after government approval.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Justice B R Gavai is currently the senior judge in the Supreme Court.**
 
• **He was elevated to the Supreme Court on May 24, 2019.**
 
• **He will take charge after CJI Khanna retires on May 13, 2025.**
 
• **He will remain in office until November 23, 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Justice B R Gavai**__

 __
 
• Hails from Amravati, Maharashtra.
 
• Was a part of key rulings including demonetisation, abrogation of Article 370, and Electoral Bonds judgement.
 
• Advocated for applying the creamy layer principle to SCs/STs for real equality.
 
 
 
• **Justice Sanjay Kishan Kaul**__
 __
 
• Recently retired from the Supreme Court in December 2023.
 
 
 
• **Justice D Y Chandrachud**__
 __
 
• Served as the 50th Chief Justice of India.
 
 
 
• **Justice S Abdul Nazeer**__
 
 
• Known for his role in the Ayodhya verdict, retired in 2023.

questions.question: What was the theme of the second edition of the Defence Literature Festival 'Kalam & Kavach 2.0'?

options.text: Securing India’s Rise through Defence Reforms

questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Securing India’s Rise through Defence Reforms**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Centre for Joint Warfare Studies Hosts Defence Literature Festival ‘Kalam & Kavach 2.0’ in New Delhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The **second edition of the Defence Literature Festival**, **‘Kalam & Kavach 2.0’**, was hosted by **CENJOWS** in collaboration with **Pentagon Press**.

 
 
• 
 
The event was held at the **Manekshaw Centre** in **New Delhi** on **April 15, 2025**.

 
 
• 
 
This year’s theme was **‘Securing India’s Rise through Defence Reforms’**.

 
 
• 
 
The focus of the event was on **Defence Technology and Future Warfare**, especially in **defence manufacturing**.

 
 
• 
 
**Raksha Mantri Rajnath Singh** declared **2025 as the ‘Year of Reforms’**, aiming to make the **Armed Forces technologically advanced and combat-ready**.

questions.question: What is the name of the mascot for Khelo India Youth Games 2025, Bihar?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Gajasimha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Khelo India Youth Games 2025: Bihar Launches Mascot 'Gaj Singh'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Nitish Kumar**, CM of Bihar, unveiled the **official logo** of **Khelo India Youth Games, Bihar 2025**.

 
 
• 
 
**Union Minister Mansukh Mandaviya** participated **remotely**, and both launched the **sports song** and **flagged off the torch**.

 
 
• 
 
**PM Narendra Modi** will **inaugurate** the event in **Patna on May 4, 2025**.

 
 
• 
 
This is the **first time** Bihar is hosting **Khelo India Youth Games**.

 
 
• 
 
The games will run from **May 4 to May 15** across **5 districts**: Patna, Nalanda (Rajgir), Gaya, Bhagalpur, Begusarai.

 
 
• 
 
**8,500 players** and **1,500 technical staff** will participate in **28 sports**—totaling around **10,000 people**.

 
 
• 
 
The **Mashal Gaurav Yatra (torch relay)** will cover **38 districts** from **April 15 to May 2**.

 
 
• 
 
The **logo** features:

 
 
• 
 
**Orange & green** (excitement & nature)

 
 
• 
 
**Mascot '****Gajasimha****'**: inspired by **Pala-period sculptures** (elephant-lion hybrid)

 
 
• 
 
Icons from **Nalanda University**, **Mahabodhi Temple**, **Peepal trees**, **Gangetic dolphins**, **Madhubani art**, **Chhath Puja**, and **Valmiki Tiger Reserve**

 
 
• 
 
**Ashok Chakra** and **lion** symbolizing **justice and strength**

 
 
• 
 
The slogan: **“Colors of the game!”** reflects Bihar’s cultural and sporting revival

questions.question: World Homoeopathy Day is observed every year on 10 April to pay tribute to the founder and father of the Homeopathy system of medicine, Dr. Christian Friedrich Samuel Hahnemann. What is its theme for 2025?

options.text: Enhancing the scope of Homoeopathy in Public Health

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Study, Teaching, Research**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **World Homoeopathy Day** is observed every year on **10 April **to pay **tribute to the founder and father** of the Homeopathy system of medicine** Dr. Christian Friedrich Samuel Hahnemann**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The day aims to **spread knowledge about Homeopathic medicine** in public health.
 
• **World Homeopathy Week** is celebrated annually from** 10 April to 16 April**.
 
• The **theme of 2025 is “**Study, Teaching, Research**”**.
 
• India, with 3.45 lakh registered homoeopathy doctors and over 277 hospitals, will host the largest symposium in **Gandhinagar, Gujarat, in 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Samuel Hahnemann** held that in order to treat a patient's sickness, the **ingredients that cause the disease's symptoms** must be administered.

 
 
• Thus, **homeopathy **works on the principle of **“like cures **like”

questions.question: Where was the first-ever ‘Himalayan High-Altitude Atmospheric & Climate Centre’ launched?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Udhampur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Union Minister Jitendra Singh Inaugurates First Himalayan Climate Centre in Udhampur.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Union Minister Jitendra Singh** launched the **first-ever Himalayan High-Altitude Atmospheric & Climate Centre** in **Nathatop, Udhampur district, J&K**.

 
 
• 
 
The centre aims to **provide accurate climate and weather forecasts** and **conduct research on the region’s high-altitude conditions**.

 
 
• 
 
The initiative is under the **Ministry of Earth Sciences**.

 
 
• 
 
The project will significantly **enhance climate monitoring** in the **Himalayas**, addressing the unique weather conditions of the region.

questions.question: What is the title of Banu Mushtaq’s short story collection that has been shortlisted for the International Booker Prize 2025?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Heart Lamp**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• ‘Heart Lamp’ becomes 1st Kannada title shortlisted for International Booker Prize 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Banu Mushtaq’s short story collection**, **‘Heart Lamp’**, has been shortlisted for the **International Booker Prize 2025**.

 
 
• 
 
The collection has been **translated from Kannada to English** by **Deepa Bhasthi**.

 
 
• 
 
This is the **first time a Kannada title** has been shortlisted for the **International Booker Prize**.

 
 
• 
 
The collection consists of **12 stories**, originally published between **1990 and 2023**.

 
 
• 
 
**Mushtaq’s work** is praised for its **witty, vivid, colloquial, moving, and excoriating style** in capturing portraits of **family and community tensions**.

 
 
• 
 
The collection is one of **six titles** shortlisted for the **International Booker Prize 2025**.

questions.question: Who will receive the Golden Lion for Lifetime Achievement award at the 2025 Venice Film Festival?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Werner Herzog**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Filmmaker Werner Herzog will be honored with the Golden Lion for Lifetime Achievement at the Venice Film Festival.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Herzog is known for films like “Fitzcarraldo” and "Nosferatu the Vampyre."**
 
• The 82-year-old director will be recognized for his significant contributions to cinema.
 
• Herzog expressed feeling deeply honored to receive the prestigious award.
 
• The Golden Lion is awarded to individuals with exceptional achievements in cinema.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Venice Film Festival__

 
 
• Established: 1932
 
• Location: Venice, Italy
 
• It is the world's oldest film festival & one of the "Big Five" International film festivals worldwide.
